classes.deleteText: {n} entry will leave it; the entry itself is kept. | {n} entries will leave it; the entries themselves are kept.
classes.explain: {mainClasses} (4WD, 2WD) split the field — an entry has one. {categories} (Rookie, Stock) cut across them — an entry has any number. Results combine any of them, e.g. Stock Rookie 2WD, with positions, gaps and notional times computed within that group. Assign them on the Entries page; the overall ranking always includes everyone.
classes.empty: No classes yet. Without any, results are one overall ranking. Add one with + {action}.

live.dismissText: It is discarded as not a car and can't be assigned afterwards. Only do this when no car can have caused it. | They are discarded as not a car and can't be assigned afterwards. Only do this when no car can have caused them.
live.unscrutineeredTitle: {n} car hasn't passed scrutineering | {n} cars haven't passed scrutineering
live.unscrutineeredText: {numbers} is on the start list and can start, but hasn't been passed yet. {verb} anyway? | {numbers} are on the start list and can start, but haven't been passed yet. {verb} anyway?
live.voidText: It stays on record but stops counting, and the car can run this stage again — the start gate will time the new attempt automatically.
live.deleteRunText: Unlike voiding, this leaves no record. Use it for a run that never happened.
live.conflictText: This stage shares gates with the currently active stage: {stages}. Activating anyway will close that stage — any of its cars still on course will be marked DNF. | This stage shares gates with the currently active stages: {stages}. Activating anyway will close those stages — any of their cars still on course will be marked DNF.
live.closeText: Its gates stop timing, cars still on stage become DNF and cars that never started DNS. Closing cannot be undone.
live.closeUnassigned: {n} unassigned passing will be discarded: a car may be missing a time. Assign it first. | {n} unassigned passings will be discarded: a car may be missing a time. Assign them first.
live.unfreezeText: It is computed live again, so a posted copy may stop matching it.
live.pendingTitle: {n} detection recorded but not timed. | {n} detections recorded but not timed.
live.pendingText: These passings are stored, but the run they belong to was not updated — so a start or finish is missing from the results. The server keeps retrying; if the count doesn't clear, fix the run by hand below.
live.noStages: No stages yet — create them under {link}.
live.liveStartList: The start list is computed live, so a time correction on an earlier stage can still move it. {freeze} — activating the stage freezes it otherwise. Order rules are under {link}.
live.freezeWhenPosted: Freeze it when you post or announce it

scoring.title: Notional times
scoring.explain: A crew that doesn't complete a closed stage is charged a {notionalTime} for it: the slowest time anyone set on that stage, plus this penalty. Without it, retiring early would look like winning — a shorter total is otherwise just the result of driving less.
scoring.ruleOfThumb: Rule of thumb: set it to roughly {oneStage}. The penalty only has to be big enough to outweigh the advantage a crew built on the stages it did finish — set it too low and a quick car can retire and still lead the rally.

penalties.pending: Counts in the overall once the stage is closed
penalties.deleteText: Every penalty of this type given so far is deleted with it.
penalties.emptyCatalogue: No penalty types yet. Add one with + {action}.
penalties.explain: Penalties are added to the overall total, never to a stage time. A type costs the same for every offence, or more the more there are: add tiers. What an offence costs is always worked out again from all of an entry's penalties of that type, so changing a type reprices penalties already given.
penalties.countedHint: Per stage, counting starts again on every stage. Per rally, it carries on through all stages.
penalties.nothingEntered: Nothing entered: a count or a free-text penalty.

startOrder.title: Start order
startOrder.explain: Applies to every stage. A stage's list is {frozen} when it is frozen on Live Timing or the stage is first activated — changes here only affect lists not yet frozen. Crews without a time start at the end of their group, and ties go by start number, so "Last stage time" on the first stage is simply start-number order.
startOrder.groupingHint: Main classes start one after another, alphabetically; cars without a main class last.
